# Issue #012: Advanced DOM Filtering for Targeted Content Extraction

## Description
Enhance the DOM filtering capabilities to allow for more precise content extraction, reducing token usage and improving response relevance.

## Requirements
- Implement advanced CSS selector support for filtering
- Add attribute-based element filtering (by class, id, data-attributes)
- Create text content filtering with regex pattern matching
- Support for limiting result depth/nesting
- Allow for selective inclusion/exclusion of element types
- Implement result formatting options (text-only, HTML, structured JSON)
- Optimize output for token efficiency when used with LLMs

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CSS selector filtering correctly identifies target elements
- [ ] Attribute filtering works for various attribute types
- [ ] Text content can be filtered by patterns
- [ ] Result depth/nesting can be controlled
- [ ] Element type filtering works as expected
- [ ] Output format options produce expected results
- [ ] Token usage is reduced compared to unfiltered content

## Technical Implementation
Enhance the existing DOM filtering functionality in the puppeteer.ts file and create a comprehensive test script (`test-advanced-filtering.js`) to validate all filtering options.

## Related Components
- src/puppeteer.ts (navigate function with responseFormat options)
- tests/test-dom-filtering.js (extend this approach)
